# Dependencies

## AS IS — Current state

### External services

| Service | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Mux | Video asset encoding/playback, webhook |
| Stripe (Cashier ^16.8) | Subscriptions, add-on purchases, invoices |
| Gemini Veo | AI photo-to-video (`GEMINI_API_KEY`, default model `veo-3.1-lite-generate-preview`, 720p) |
| AWS S3 | File storage |
| Brevo (SMTP) / Mailpit | Outbound mail / Sail mail catcher |
| fonts.bunny.net | Feed title fonts (`config/feed.php`) |

### Internal libraries

None: no private/first-party packages in `composer.json`. Code lives under `App\`.

### Shared infrastructure

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| MySQL 8.4 | Primary DB (Sail) |
| Queue | `database` driver default; Sail `queue` container `queue:work --tries=1 --sleep=3 --timeout=900` |
| Scheduler | `videos:prune` daily 04:00 `onOneServer` |
| Cache | `CACHE_STORE` env-driven |
| Observability | `laravel/pail` (dev); no APM found |
| CI | none |

Runtime packages: laravel/framework ^13.17, livewire ^4.4, filament ^5.0, laravel/cashier ^16.8, aws-sdk-php ^3.397, flysystem-aws-s3-v3 ^3.0, chillerlan/php-qrcode ^5.0, tinker ^3.0. Dev: pest ^4.7, phpunit ^12.5.12, mockery ^1.6, faker ^1.23, pint ^1.27, sail ^1.68, pail, pao ^1.0.6 (purpose undetermined), collision.
